name: @nonsuch/component-library
description: A Vue 3 component library built on Quasar with opinionated defaults and custom components.

scripts.build: vite build && rm -f tsconfig.build.tsbuildinfo && vue-tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build

size-limit.name: full library (gzip) — a SOFT ceiling. 33 kB as of 2026-09-15: NsCombo + NsPlanHeader/Highlights/Features (componentLibrary-lrw.5) took it 31.43 → 32.26, +830 B for four exported components, three of which NsPlanBuilder (lrw.6) will reuse; `{ NsCombo }` = 4.66 kB against `{ NsButton, nsLocaleEnCA }` = 3.47, so ~1.2 kB for the four together. Before that, 32 kB on 2026-09-14: NsChecklistBanner took it 30.17 → 31.38; `{ NsChecklistBanner }` = 4.97 kB against `{ NsBadge, NsButton, nsLocaleEnCA }` = 3.6, so ~1.2 kB of its own, ~0.2 of that the en-CA `checklist` strings every locale consumer pays. Earlier the same day, 31 kB: NsHoursOfOperation (componentLibrary-f6b) took it 26.78 → 30.16, the largest single addition to date — a compound input of eight days × (two selects, a checkbox, add and remove buttons) with its own live region and focus choreography; ~2 kB of it is the per-range row template, whose remove button appears twice so CSS can place it per breakpoint. Measured before bumping, gzip with vue/quasar/phosphor ignored: `{ NsHoursOfOperation }` = 7.16 kB; `{ NsSelect, NsCheckbox, NsButton }` = 3.42 kB; the same plus `nsLocaleEnCA` (which the component pulls through useNsLocale's default) = 4.16 kB. So the component's own code is ~3.0 kB counting the locale as a dependency, ~3.7 kB not. Previously 27 kB as of 2026-09-12 (NsImageUpload +1.8 kB across two review passes; the dev warnings are ~3.3 kB in total and only dual conditional exports reclaims them — see componentLibrary-49m). RE-SET rather than drift: when a bump is needed, write the reason here.
single component: NsBrandLogo (must not pull more than NsImage, which is 1.38 kB)
single component: NsHoursOfOperation (largest in the sign-up flow; pulls NsSelect, NsCheckbox, NsButton, the en-CA locale)

app shell (heaviest import; 11.25 kB as of 2026-09-15 — the en-CA `stepper` and `plan` strings took it 10.99 → 11.01, over the 11 kB line by 10 B; every locale section lands here because the shell pulls en-CA. Before that, 11 kB as of 2026-09-14 — the en-CA `hours` strings for NsHoursOfOperation cost every locale consumer 200 B, measured 10.67 → 10.87 on this row against main d207a2c (an earlier draft said 122, which was the overage, not the delta); contains NsInput and NsNavSidebar. Includes the en-CA locale object — a ONE-TIME 440 B for the first useNsLocale() consumer in this chunk, ~0 for the next)
manifest subpath (build tooling; must never pull runtime code)

styles (gzip) — ALSO A SOFT CEILING, 8 kB as of 2026-09-14 (NsChecklistBanner: 7.24 → 7.61, +370 B — a card, a task row with a mobile column / desktop row switch, a step circle and a badge). Earlier the same day, 7.5 kB: NsHoursOfOperation 6.76 → 7.24. Was 7 kB as of 2026-09-12 (NsImageUpload +363 B). Same rule as the JS row: re-set with a reason, never drift.
